card.name: Words leading into an action noun
card.fires_on: Linking words such as after, following, upon, by, or overall that come right before a noun for an action or event like use, initiation, removal, or discontinuation. Also partway through discontinuation-type words.

modes.label: Time link before an event
modes.description: After or following a time span, just before a noun naming a dose, initiation, or removal.
modes.example: Eighteen hours<< following>> the removal of the fentanyl transder

modes.label: By or upon before an action
modes.description: A short linking word or the start of the word discontinuation, before an action noun.
modes.example: Epithelial corneal edema typically resolves<< upon>> discontinuation of RHOPRESSA.

modes.label: Responsibility phrase
modes.description: The word overall after responsible for, before a project noun.
modes.example: UCLA is responsible for<< overall>> Dawn mission science.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict action nouns such as use, creation, formation, removal, and completion next.
card.plain: It fires on small words that set up an upcoming action or event, like after, following, or by.
